eps.ov: A chance encounter with a stranger introduces Ko to a nocturnal life. Ko follows her and why shouldn’t he? The night is still young.
eps.oa: لقاء عابر مع غريبة يعرّف «كو» بحياة الليل. يتبعها، ولمَ لا؟ فالليل ما زال في أوله.

eps.ov: How can you fall in love with a vampire when you can’t even track them down!? Nazuma remains frustratingly elusive, but Ko may have a nostalgic solution to this new problem.
eps.oa: كيف تقع في حب مصاصة دماء وأنت لا تستطيع حتى أن تعثر عليها!؟ «نازونا» عصيّة على اللقاء على نحو مغيظ، لكن قد يكون عند «كو» حل قديم الطراز لهذه المشكلة الجديدة.

eps.ov: When can you start calling someone a friend? What even IS friendship, anyway? As Ko reconnects with a classmate, questions arise he isn’t sure he knows how to answer.

eps.t: 4th Night: Isn't This a Tight Squeeze?
eps.ov: Three’s a crowd when Ko invites Akira to hang out with him and Nazuna late one evening.
How does Nazuna make money, anyway? Ko is about to get the inside scoop on her (very suspicious) business, but first he’ll need to make sense of his complicated emotions.

eps.t: 6th Night: Might as Well Have Fun
eps.ov: Ko doesn’t need a mirror to see his reflection. It’s staring right back at him in the form of Nazuna’s latest client.
Boredom drove Ko into the night. Boredom drove Ko’s new acquaintance to killing time in her own way. She and Ko seem very similar… perhaps TOO similar for comfort.
Ko thought he had all the time in the world, but the revelation of an unexpected deadline changes everything. Hopefully his friends (new and old alike) will have some advice.
Seri is extremely popular, but popularity isn’t all it’s cracked up to be when one of her human paramours develops feelings she isn’t ready to deal with.
It’s not all sparkles and hearts at the maid café where Midori works. Someone is creeping on a certain maid, but uncovering the interloper isn’t as easy as it looks…

eps.t: 11th Night: Do You Know What a Vampire Is?
eps.ov: Nazuna needs new blood for her cuddle-buddy business, and Ko is on the case! But he’s not the only one wandering the night looking for someone…
What does it mean to be a vampire? Why does Ko want to become one? A chat with a friend reveals Ko’s lack of answers to these all-important questions.
The night feels distant. Ko isn’t sure how to close that gap.
